description: The final season follows the group through grief, new relationships, public identity and the approach of adulthood as Spencer and Ashley repeatedly test whether their bond can survive change.

s03e01.description: The group faces the immediate aftermath of tragedy, with grief and anger pulling friendships in directions no one is prepared to manage.

s03e02.description: Money and privilege complicate affection as Ashley's choices test whether generosity can repair emotional damage.

s03e03.description: Spencer and Ashley encounter a more glamorous social world whose attention creates new pressure on their relationship and self-image.

s03e04.description: A new relationship changes the balance between Spencer and Ashley, forcing both to confront jealousy and unfinished feelings.

s03e05.description: Uncomfortable revelations spread through the group, making honesty costly but leaving deception even harder to sustain.

s03e06.description: The friends become entangled in a dangerous situation that turns youthful confidence into a more serious test of judgment and loyalty.

s03e07.description: A night out turns confrontational as romantic tension, pride and unresolved anger finally stop behaving politely.

s03e08.description: Spencer navigates public identity and community expectations while deciding how much of herself she wants to define through labels.

s03e09.description: Plans for life after school expose how differently the group imagines adulthood, ambition and the futures of their relationships.

s03e10.description: Spencer's milestone birthday becomes a measure of how much has changed in her family, friendships and relationship with Ashley.

s03e11.description: A revelation no one particularly wanted forces the group to reconsider assumptions that had been keeping several relationships comfortable.

s03e12.description: Romance becomes harder to separate from trust as Spencer, Ashley and their friends confront the consequences of recent choices.

s03e13.description: Long-delayed decisions finally arrive, offering some relationships another chance while making others impossible to restore.

s03e14.description: Old history resurfaces just as the characters make plans for what comes next, forcing them to reconcile who they were with who they are becoming.

s03e15.description: Second chances tempt several characters, but revisiting old relationships also revives the reasons they failed the first time.

s03e16-17.description: As graduation and adulthood approach, Spencer, Ashley and their friends make final choices about love, family and the lives they intend to build.
